question.text: Per the Ministry of Corporate Affairs' CSR spending data for FY 2022-23 cited in Ch 1.9.1, which two sectors received the HIGHEST CSR funding?

answer.text: Gender Equality (Rs 10,000 cr) and Slum Development (Rs 6,800 cr)
Education (Rs 10,085.38 cr) and Health Care (Rs 6,830.41 cr)
Environmental conservation (Rs 15,000 cr) and Heritage (Rs 8,000 cr)
Sports (Rs 9,000 cr) and Disaster management (Rs 7,500 cr)

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 1.9.1, in FY 2022-23 CSR spending was highest on Education (Rs 10,085.38 cr) and Health Care (Rs 6,830.41 cr). The chapter notes Gender Equality, Women Empowerment, Old Age Homes, Reduced Inequalities (GWOR) and Slum Development need MORE funding support — implying they are UNDER-funded, not top-funded. The Trap: Option A swaps the under-funded sectors as top-funded — a reversal trap. Options C and D are fabricated figures. Note: The workbook contrasts the top-funded sectors (Education, Health Care) with the under-funded ones (GWOR, Slum Development) to highlight where additional CSR support is needed.
